senses.gloss: (√אף, v. אפף; cmp. חפץ) to press, squeeze, contract.—Part. pass. אָפוּץ. Ohol. IX, 3 a gap which was filled with straw או אֲפוּצָה or was made narrower by squeezing the parts together (e.g. pressing the lid down). Tosef. ib. X, 6 אֲפוּסָה a narrowing of the gap by pressing.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:7:12">Y. Sabb. III, 6ᶜ</cite> <he>באפוצה</he> when the wick is compressed in the candlestick. Ib. V, beg. 7ᵇ <he>באֲפוּצִים</he> when the vessels are closely packed.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 1:1:17">Y. Pes. I, 27ᶜ</cite> top <he>אֲפוּצוֹת</he>.
